import { describe, expect, test } from "bun:test";
import { Note } from "./note.ts";
import { NoteId } from "./note-id.ts";
import { NoteText } from "./note-text.ts";

function text(raw: string): NoteText {
  const parsed = NoteText.parse(raw);
  if (!parsed.ok) throw new Error(parsed.error);
  return parsed.value;
}

describe("Note", () => {
  test("is equal to a note with the same identity, whatever its text", () => {
    const id = NoteId.generate();
    expect(new Note(id, text("First")).equals(new Note(id, text("Second")))).toBe(true);
    expect(new Note(NoteId.generate(), text("Same")).equals(new Note(NoteId.generate(), text("Same")))).toBe(false);
  });

  test("serialises its identity and text", () => {
    const note = new Note(NoteId.generate(), text("Buy milk"));
    expect(note.toJSON()).toEqual({ id: note.id.value, text: "Buy milk" });
  });
});
